events.title: iPod’s 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Music in your pocket
angles.copy: Remember the world before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple changed everything. Suddenly, your entire music collection could fit in your pocket. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic theme tunes to unforgettable gadgets, 007 has given us so much. Which Bond theme is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician and songwriter John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine his legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's the Lennon track that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Ministry of Silly Walks
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless. What’s your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: A blank canvas of sound
angles.copy: Forty-eight years ago today, The Beatles gave us the 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that broke all the rules. Which track from this iconic double LP is a must-listen for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the inimitable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind. What's your favourite Queen song that showcases his genius?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A turning point in pop
angles.copy: Fifty-nine years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul' – an album that pushed boundaries and showed a new depth to their songwriting. Which track from this classic stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: A voice for peace
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and enduring message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's the song that best captures his spirit for you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The iconic musician David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. A true innovator whose influence is still felt across music and culture. What's your favourite Bowie era or alter-ego?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the one and only Elvis Presley. His impact on music is immeasurable. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God turns 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the absolute guitar legend, Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs are iconic. What's your favourite Pagey moment or solo?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Sir Rod Stewart! That distinctive voice has given us decades of hits. What's your favourite Rod the Mod anthem?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the iconic lead singer of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Our House in the middle of his birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing us absolute bangers for decades. What's your favourite Madness track to get you skanking?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)", celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat...
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! An 80s legend with timeless tracks. What's your favourite Paul Young song?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon Dolly Parton, who passed away in 2026, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: A rhinestone tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been her 81st birthday, we're celebrating the incredible life and music of Dolly Parton. Her legacy shines brighter than ever. What's your favourite Dolly classic?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Back for Good at 56
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the one and only Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo hits, he's a true pop institution. What's your favourite Gary Barlow penned track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of international hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Get Outta My Dreams...
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the legend that is Billy Ocean! His feel-good anthems are guaranteed to brighten any day. What's your favourite Billy Ocean hit?
